# structuredmerge-core - FFI (C/C++) Bindings

Typed polyglot StructuredMerge kernel

## Installation

Link against `libstructuredmerge_core_ffi` and include `structuredmerge_core.h`.

See the build instructions in the main repository.

## Quick Start

```c
#include "structuredmerge_core.h"

int main(void) {
    // See https://github.com/structuredmerge/structuredmerge for usage examples.
    return 0;
}
```

## Documentation

For full documentation, see the [structuredmerge-core repository](https://github.com/structuredmerge/structuredmerge).
